label: Voice
summary: Reads exact words aloud and returns the audio with a timing for every word (for captions): the author's cloned voice, or a studio narrator when a reel asks for one. Its prompt is the exact words to say, nothing else (no "read this" lead-in). Only for a request to read given words; trailers, explainers, premise reels and campaigns narrate themselves. Uses voice credits: one script per request.
